Clocks/BaseClock.luau.description: Base Clock provides the module implementation used by the Timesyncservice package.

Clocks/MasterClock.luau.description: Master clock on the server Public entry points include `MasterClock.new`, `handleRequestSync`, `handleDelayRequest`, `MasterClock.GetClockFunction`, `MasterClock.ObservePing`, `MasterClock.IsSynced`, `MasterClock.GetPing`, `MasterClock.GetTime`.

Clocks/SlaveClock.luau.description: Slave clock on the client Public entry points include `SlaveClock.new`, `handleSyncPulse`, `SlaveClock.GetClockFunction`, `SlaveClock.ObservePing`, `SlaveClock.TickToSyncedTime`, `SlaveClock.GetTime`, `SlaveClock.IsSynced`, `SlaveClock.GetPing`.

Constants/TimeSyncConstants.luau.description: Time Sync Constants provides the class/model implementation used by the Timesyncservice package.

TimeSyncService.luau.description: Syncronizes time between the server and client. This creates a shared timestamp that can be used to reasonably time events between the server and client. Public entry points include `TimeSyncService.Init`, `TimeSyncService.IsSynced`, `buildMockClock`, `mock.IsSynced`, `mock.GetTime`, `mock.GetPing`, `mock.GetClockFunction`, `mock.ObservePing`.

Util/TimeSyncUtils.luau.description: Helper functions for the TimeSyncService. Public entry points include `TimeSyncUtils.promiseClockSynced`.
